verdict.rationale: Fireworks' own docs list text, vision, audio, image and embedding models on the same platform. Vision has a dedicated section for analyzing images and documents and appears in its model recommendations and prompt-cache pricing. The API reference also covers language, image and embedding models under one API key. Missing for 10: detailed docs on audio (transcription or speech) endpoints, explicit documentation of image-generation calls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
